items.coder_A: Participants are caregivers of glioblastoma patients (patients also complete questionnaires); glioblastoma is named in the conditions but the enrolled population is not a patient treatment population.
items.reason: Caregiver behavioural intervention ('Family caregivers (≥18 years) to patients (≥18 years) diagnosed with a GBM grade IV'); phase NA, so it is excluded at S3 (phase_not_applicable) by the script before S5, and it would also fail S6. The S5 value cannot change the outcome.
A non-drug intervention is under test ('Project SUGRI: A supportive group intervention for caregivers to patients with a glioblastoma'), so no_pharmacological_candidate does not apply under D31-C1.

note: Excluded at S3 (phase NA) before S5/S6 apply. S6 reason changed to excluded_intervention_type under D31-C1 (behavioural caregiver intervention under test); no effect on inclusion.

revisions.reason: The record tests a non-drug intervention ('A supportive group intervention' for caregivers), and D31-C1 reserves no_pharmacological_candidate for trials with no non-drug intervention under test.
